observations: DescribeSnapshots, DescribeSnapshotAttribute and CreateVolume DryRun agree on the error code for all37 initial variants.

Previously issued deleted IDs return InvalidSnapshot.NotFound. The source initialization snapshot was already deleted before this supplement; its prior live success and verified absence remain in volume_controls_initialization.json.
Eight-hex all-zero, all-one, all-f and two source-derived variants return InvalidSnapshot.NotFound; their contents are not rejected by the observed admission layer.

Seventeen-hex all-zero/all-one/all-f and0123456789abcdef0 return InvalidSnapshotID.Malformed. Leading0 plus17lowercase hex digits is insufficient:01111111111111111 is malformed, while0ffffffffffffffff and0fedcba9876543210 reachNotFound.
Replacing the proven source's leading0 with1 orf is malformed. Uppercase source hex returns InvalidParameterValue with Expected: 'snap-...'.
For0400dc0055e85b9bf, incrementing each separate nibble at positions1,2,5 through12 still reachesNotFound. Mutations at3,4,13 through16 can be malformed.
Full0..f sweeps at the six affected positions yield different admitted digit sets for two proven-issued IDs. A fixed independent per-position whitelist does not explain the observations.

Both east-issued IDs and one west-issued ID reachNotFound at both regional endpoints. Every sampled western-ID mutation has the same classification in east and west; this sample does not exhibit endpoint-region routing differences.
nibble_indexing: Zero-based index into the17hex digits after snap-. Other digits remain identical to the named baseline. NotFound means passed the observed malformed-ID check, not that the identifier was ever issued.
derivation_limits: No universal checksum, type/version field decoder, or backend-routing decoder has been established. These observations cannot justify a fixture blacklist or a guessed decoder.
Many admitted single-nibble mutations do not identify a whole-ID checksum algorithm, nor do they prove the absence of an internal checksum over selected bits.
Agreement across two endpoints does not exclude global backend topology or an internal structural decoder shared across endpoints.
Only read-only and DryRun requests were made for arbitrary variants. No snapshot state, permissions, account settings or roles were changed.
